checks.name: mapper_export
checks.finding: A fresh scalar 4x4 FMCW window mapping succeeds and exports configuration, DFG and bitcode. This is not execution.

checks.name: floating_point_opcode_compatibility
checks.finding: The pinned cgramapper:v1 DFGNode.cpp translates fmul to OPT_MUL, fadd to OPT_ADD and fsub to OPT_SUB. Window config contains OPT_MUL, not OPT_FMUL. The Neura VectorCGRA MulRTL implements integer bit-vector multiplication.

probe.scope: MulRTL functional unit; pure PyMTL simulation, not translated Verilog or full CGRA

checks.name: whole_frame_execution
checks.finding: No end-to-end FMCW harness found in inspected CGRA-Flow/VectorCGRA paths. The universal template test manually builds load/inc/store control packets; it is not a mapper-config importer or FMCW executor. Its FP units are commented out.

checks.name: synthesis
checks.finding: Local Neura image has Yosys and Verilator; dc_shell was not found on the host PATH or in that image. No matching candidate RTL has been validated, so no candidate area/clock is reported. MACO arch2dc.bash execution_time measures synthesis wall time, NOT application latency.

next_required_work: Preserve floating-point semantics in a separate compiler-to-RTL adapter and verify opcode/port/register/constant encodings.
Bind an explicit FP-capable architecture, memory map and latency model.
Build configuration/data loading, output checking and full-frame cycle accounting before synthesizing the compared candidates.
